facts.evidence: "Solomon son of David married women, seven hundred concubines" gives Solomon, his father David, and many women.
"did not find among them a child, not even one" says none of them bore him offspring. "Child" is used where the French says "son", a negligible difference.
"God Most High did not consent that the seed of Canaan be joined with the seed of the holy people"
"the people from whom our Lord Jesus Christ took flesh"
"All of them, the wives of Solomon, were of the seed of Canaan."

review_only_differences: The candidate gives "women, seven hundred concubines" rather than 700 wives and 80 concubines. This was not scored.

facts.evidence: "God [made?] Moses a prophet" is hedged, but it identifies Moses as a prophet of God.
"Levi, when he went with his father to the land of Egypt"
"there were born Moses, and Tsemaran(?), and Joshua son of Nun, and Caleb"
"Joshua son of Nun"
"when they threw him into the river"
"Sefir(?), daughter of Pharaoh, took him and brought him into her house"

review_only_differences: The names Tsemaran and Sefir are transliteration variants of Te‘mrân and Sâfir. They were not penalised.

facts.evidence: "fled ... because of fear of Pharaoh"
"to Radabil(?), the priest of Midian"
"there he married a wife (of the house) of Raguel"
"he begot two from (among) the children of…" shows two offspring, but the clause is truncated and adds an unclear "children of…" qualifier.

unsupported_additions: "from (among) the children of…" is a trailing fragment not in the French. It is probably an artifact of the broken text.
review_only_differences: The priest is named Radabil, then Raguel, versus Râ‘ow’él. This is a name reading difference and was not scored.
The candidate has "a wife (of the house) of Raguel" where the French has "the sister of Râ‘ou’él". This was not scored.

facts.evidence: "after Moses died, the son of Nun judged the people". Joshua is recoverable from "son of Nun".
"after him Kus the apostate judged them — ... eight years"
"Gotonyal son of Kenez, the brother of Caleb"
"the children of Israel were enslaved to Eglom, king of Moab"
"God delivered them from his hand"
"Na'od son of Gera judged them eighty years"
"in the ... year of Na'od's judgeship four thousand (years) from creation were completed"

review_only_differences: Joshua's judging period is 24 years in the candidate versus 31 in the French.
The servitude to Eglon is 108 years versus 18.
Ehud's anniversary year is the 17th versus the 27th.
None of these numeric differences was scored.
